name: feature.app-builder.agents
description: App Architect agent. Turns a product idea into a structured multi-screen app design persisted as an editable App Builder canvas — a tool-first exchange (ADR 0358): the agent REQUESTS the closed component catalog, READS existing designs before modifying them, and renders through the host's validated tools; no catalog is hand-copied into the prompt. Composes the AI chat; no new chat surface. Pure-agent pack.
author: OpenWOP App
